title: Supermart Replenishment Hub
description: Lakebase data for Supermart, a Singapore grocer: store stock position, 14-day forecast, agent stock-out signals and recommendations, decisions and queued e-mails.
instructions: All data is mock data for Supermart, a Singapore grocer. The business date is pinned to 2026-12-07: never use current_date(); treat 2026-12-07 as today.

gold_replenishment_position has one row per store_id and sku with on_hand, open_po_qty and days_of_cover. It is the only table with store_name; join other tables to it on store_id to name a store (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name).

ml_forecast holds a daily unit forecast per store_id, sku and biz_date for the 14 days from 2026-12-07; p10 and p90 are the low and high case. Forecast vs on-hand: join to gold_replenishment_position on store_id and sku and compare on_hand with SUM(forecast) over the next 14 days (biz_date < date '2026-12-21'). Use the highest model_version only.

agent_signals are the stores and products the agent flagged: kind is 'stockout' or 'excess_po', severity is 'high' or 'medium', and status starts as 'awaiting decision' and becomes 'e-mail sent' after approval. A store is flagged when it has an agent_signals row.
agent_recommendations hold the options for each signal (join on signal_id). status is 'proposed', 'approved', 'rejected' or 'not chosen'. Decisions approved = status = 'approved'.
decision_log is the audit trail (action such as 'approved and sent' or 'rejected', actor, source ui/agent/seed). outbox holds the store-manager e-mails that were queued; they are never actually sent.
Show units as whole numbers, days of cover and percentages to 1 decimal.
sample_questions: Which stores are flagged by the agent, and how severe is each flag?
Compare the next 14 days of forecast with on-hand stock for the lowest days of cover
How many recommendations were approved, rejected or are still proposed?
Which decisions were logged most recently, and who made them?
What outbox messages were queued, and to whom?

example_sqls.question: Which stores are flagged by the agent, and how severe is each flag?
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT g.store_name, s.severity, s.kind, s.status, s.title
FROM {{catalog}}.supermart_replen.agent_signals s
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM {{catalog}}.supermart_replen.gold_replenishment_position) g ON g.store_id = s.store_id
ORDER BY s.severity, g.store_name

example_sqls.question: Compare the next 14 days of forecast with on-hand stock for the lowest days of cover
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT p.store_name, p.product_name, p.on_hand, ROUND(SUM(f.forecast)) AS forecast_14d, p.days_of_cover
FROM {{catalog}}.supermart_replen.gold_replenishment_position p
JOIN {{catalog}}.supermart_replen.ml_forecast f ON f.store_id = p.store_id AND f.sku = p.sku
WHERE f.biz_date >= DATE'2026-12-07' AND f.biz_date < DATE'2026-12-21'
  AND f.model_version = (SELECT MAX(model_version) FROM {{catalog}}.supermart_replen.ml_forecast)
GROUP BY p.store_name, p.product_name, p.on_hand, p.days_of_cover
ORDER BY p.days_of_cover ASC
LIMIT 20

example_sqls.question: How many recommendations were approved, rejected or are still proposed?
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS recommendations
FROM {{catalog}}.supermart_replen.agent_recommendations
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY recommendations DESC
